title: Revise one issue at a time
summary: Prompt improvement works best when you identify a concrete failure. Change the request to address that failure, then check old cases again.
introduction: Prompt improvement works best when you identify a concrete failure. Change the request to address that failure, then check old cases again. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain revise one issue at a time
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Prompt improvement works best when you identify a concrete failure. Change the request to address that failure, then check old cases again.

blocks.code:
Problem: the reply uses unexplained jargon.
Revision: explain each new programming word the first time it appears.
Check: does the revised reply explain variable and loop?
blocks.title: Revise one issue at a time

blocks.text: The revision targets the observed problem. Comparing before and after shows whether it helped.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a revision for a reply that ignored the requested bullet count.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not change many unrelated rules at once if you want to know which change helped.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
